시편-65-1.title: 시편 65장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-65-1.exegesis: 9-10. Men, generally, will acknowledge God's work, and the righteous, rejoicing in it, shall be encouraged to trust Him ( Psa 58:10 ).
시편-65-1.theologicalNote: 9-10. Men, generally, will acknowledge God's work, and the righteous, rejoicing in it, shall be encouraged to trust Him ( Psa 58:10 ).

시편-65-2.title: 시편 65장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-65-2.exegesis: PSALM 65 Psa 65:1-13 . This is a song of praise for God's spiritual blessings to His people and His kind providence over all the earth. 1. Praise waiteth for thee-- literally, "To Thee silence praise," or (compare Psa 62:1 ), To Thee silence is praise--that is, Praise is waiting as a servant; it is due to Thee. So the last clause expresses the duty of paying vows. These two parts of acceptable worship, mentioned in Psa 50:14 , are rendered in Zion, where God chiefly displays His mercy and receives homage.

시편-65-3.title: 시편 65장 3절 역사문법적 주해
시편-65-3.exegesis: 2. All are encouraged to pray by God's readiness to hear.
시편-65-3.theologicalNote: 2. All are encouraged to pray by God's readiness to hear.

시편-65-4.title: 시편 65장 4절 역사문법적 주해
시편-65-4.exegesis: 3. God's mercy alone delivers us from the burden of iniquities, by purging or expiating by an atonement the transgressions with which we are charged, and which are denoted by-- Iniquities-- or, literally, "Words of iniquities."
시편-65-4.theologicalNote: 3. God's mercy alone delivers us from the burden of iniquities, by purging or expiating by an atonement the transgressions with which we are charged, and which are denoted by-- Iniquities-- or, literally, "Words of iniquities."

시편-65-5.title: 시편 65장 5절 역사문법적 주해
시편-65-5.exegesis: 4. dwell in thy courts; ... [and] satisfied with the goodness ... temple-- denote communion with God ( Psa 15:1 ; 23:6 ; compare Psa 5:7 ). This is a blessing for all God's people, as denoted by the change of number.
시편-65-5.theologicalNote: 4. dwell in thy courts; ... [and] satisfied with the goodness ... temple-- denote communion with God ( Psa 15:1 ; 23:6 ; compare Psa 5:7 ). This is a blessing for all God's people, as denoted by the change of number.

시편-65-6.title: 시편 65장 6절 역사문법적 주해
시편-65-6.exegesis: 5. terrible things-- that is, by the manifestation of justice and wrath to enemies, accompanying that of mercy to His people (Psa 63:9-11; 64:7-9). the confidence-- object of it. of all ... earth-- the whole world; that is, deservedly such, whether men think so or not.
시편-65-6.theologicalNote: 5. terrible things-- that is, by the manifestation of justice and wrath to enemies, accompanying that of mercy to His people (Psa 63:9-11; 64:7-9). the confidence-- object of it. of all ... earth-- the whole world; that is, deservedly such, whether men think so or not.

시편-65-7.title: 시편 65장 7절 역사문법적 주해
시편-65-7.exegesis: 6-13. God's great power and goodness are the grounds of this confidence. These are illustrated in His control of the mightiest agencies of nature and nations affecting men with awe and dread ( Psa 26:7 ; 98:1 , &c.), and in His fertilizing showers, causing the earth to produce abundantly for man and beast.
